verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own docs say you can add a webhook URL as an alert recipient for project alerts (new errors), and uptime monitors can also send alerts via webhook, so it does ship registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Coverage is limited to those alert triggers rather than a general event-subscription system, and nothing documents the webhook payload or its behavior. missing for 10: documented payload schema, broader event-type selection beyond issue/uptime alerts, signing/verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
